definitions: Any of three breeds of dog with a distinctive ridge of hair that runs against the grain of the rest of the coat along the spine: the Rhodesian Ridgeback, the Phu Quoc Ridgeback and the Thai Ridgeback.

blocks.text: Ridgeback is a British bicycle brand manufacturing road, urban, utility, youth and mountain models. Their bikes are distributed by Sportline UK which is owned by H Young Holdings. Sportline UK also owns the Genesis and Saracen cycle brands.

Ridgeback Resources Inc. is a Calgary, Alberta-based private oil exploration and production company focused on light oil in the Bakken and Cardium resource plays, in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin.
